#Figure S1:

```{r}
ancestry_paths_z_score_data <- read.table("../final_sup_figures_data/S1_ancestry_paths_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt", header = TRUE)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)

# Read data
combined_data <- ancestry_paths_z_score_data

# Assign alternating purple shades per chromosome
combined_data$color <- ifelse(as.numeric(combined_data$CHR) %% 2 == 0, "#d35400", "#f5cba7")  # dark and light orange


# Get average index per chromosome
chr_positions <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(CHR) %>%
  summarise(chr_index = mean(index)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Gene label positions (x = previous chromosome, y = ±4)
gene_labels <- data.frame(
  gene = c("HLA", "FADS", "SLC24A5", "TMEM117"),
  CHR = c(6, 11, 14, 11),
  y = c(4, -3.7, -3.7, 4)
) %>%
  left_join(chr_positions, by = "CHR") %>%
  # Shift to previous chromosome’s index if possible
  mutate(CHR_prev = CHR - 1) %>%
  left_join(chr_positions, by = c("CHR_prev" = "CHR"), suffix = c("", "_prev")) %>%
  mutate(x = ifelse(!is.na(chr_index_prev), chr_index_prev, chr_index)) %>%
  select(gene, x, y)



# Create Manhattan plot
manhattan_plot <- ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = index, y = weighted_z, color = color)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(3, -3), color = "black", linetype = "solid") +

  # Add line labels (using annotate)
  annotate("text", x = max(combined_data$index) * 0.98, y = 3, label = "Z = 3", hjust = 1, vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = max(combined_data$index) * 0.98, y = -3, label = "Z = -3", hjust = 1, vjust = 1.3, size = 3) +

  
    # Gene annotations
  
  scale_color_identity() +
  labs(x = "Chromosome", y = "Average Z-score") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

# Prepare data for QQ plot
qq_data <- combined_data %>%
  dplyr::select(p_value = p_value) %>%
  mutate(p_value = as.numeric(p_value)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_value) & p_value > 0)

# Create QQ plot
qq_plot <- {
  n <- length(qq_data$p_value)
  observed <- -log10(sort(qq_data$p_value))
  expected <- -log10(ppoints(n))
  
  ggplot(data.frame(expected, observed), aes(x = expected, y = observed)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "gray40", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(x = "Expected", y = "Observed") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )
}

# Combine plots side by side using cowplot
combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  manhattan_plot,
  qq_plot,
  labels = c("A", "B"),
  label_size = 12,
  rel_widths = c(2.5, 1.5)
)

# Save to PDF
ggsave("FigureS1.pdf", combined_plot, width = 8, height = 3.75)


```

```{r}
# METHOD AND ROW/COL ORDER

row_order <- c("ADMIXTURE","ancestry_paths","simplai","rfmix","rfmix_filtered","mosaic","mosaic_filtered","ancestry_hmm","ancestry_hmm_filtered")

panel_methods <- list(
  `7v48` = c("ADMIXTURE","mosaic","ancestry_paths","ancestry_hmm","rfmix","simplai","qpadm","rfmix_filtered","ancestry_hmm_filtered","mosaic_filtered"),
  `7v7`  = c("ADMIXTURE","mosaic","ancestry_hmm","rfmix","simplai","qpadm","rfmix_filtered","ancestry_hmm_filtered","mosaic_filtered"),

)

# FUNCTION TO READ FILES
read_method_file <- function(path, method) {
  df <- read.table(path, header=TRUE)
  colnames(df) <- c("sample", paste0("global_ancestry_", method))
  return(df)
}

# FUNCTION TO BUILD EACH PANEL
make_plot <- function(qp_df, method_df, method_name) {
  df_plot <- inner_join(qp_df, method_df, by = "sample")
  colnames(df_plot) <- c("sample","qpAdm","method_val")
  
  if (nrow(df_plot)==0 || all(is.na(df_plot$method_val))) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  }
  
  # stats
  R_val     <- cor(df_plot$qpAdm, df_plot$method_val)
  beta_val  <- coef(lm(method_val ~ qpAdm, df_plot))[2]
  delta_val <- mean(abs(df_plot$method_val - df_plot$qpAdm))
  
  # color
  point_color <- if (method_name == "ADMIXTURE") {
    colors["ADMIXED"]
  } else {
    colors[[method_name]]
  }
  
  ggplot(df_plot, aes(qpAdm, method_val)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.8, size=1.5, color=point_color) +
    geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE, color="firebrick") +
    geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.00, y = 0.60,
             label = bquote(R == .(round(R_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.00, y = 0.50,
             label = bquote(beta == .(round(beta_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.30, y = 0.10,
             label = bquote(Delta == .(round(delta_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,0.45), ylim=c(0,0.8)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(2,2,2,2),
      axis.title  = element_blank(),
      axis.text   = element_text(size=6)
    )
}

# BUILD PLOT MATRIX
plot_matrix <- list()
for(method in row_order){
  for(panel in col_order){
    paths <- panel_paths[[panel]]
    method_subset <- panel_methods[[panel]]
    
    # read panel inputs
    dfs <- map2(paths, method_subset, read_method_file)
    
    # get qpAdm df
    qp_idx <- which(method_subset=="qpadm")
    qp_df <- dfs[[qp_idx]]
    colnames(qp_df) <- c("sample","global_ancestry_qpadm")
    
    # handle rows that don't exist
    if(!(method %in% method_subset) || method=="qpadm"){
      plot_matrix[[length(plot_matrix)+1]] <- ggplot() + theme_void()
      next
    }
    
    method_idx <- which(method_subset == method)
    method_df <- dfs[[method_idx]]
    plot_matrix[[length(plot_matrix)+1]] <- make_plot(qp_df, method_df, method)
  }
}

# TOP AND LEFT LABELS
top_labels <- lapply(col_order, function(lab) ggdraw() + draw_label(lab, fontface="bold", size=12))


#try:
row_labels <- c(
  ADMIXTURE              = "ADMIXTURE",
  ancestry_paths         = "Ancestry Paths",
  simplai                = "SimplAI",
  rfmix                  = "RFMix",
  rfmix_filtered         = "0.9 filtered",
  mosaic                 = "MOSAIC",
  mosaic_filtered        = "0.9 filtered",
  ancestry_hmm           = "Ancestry HMM",
  ancestry_hmm_filtered  = "0.9 filtered"
)

left_labels <- lapply(row_order, function(m) {
  ggdraw() +
    draw_label(
      row_labels[[m]],
      angle = 90,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 10,
      vjust = 0.1,
      hjust = 0.5
    )
})



# ASSEMBLE GRID
panel_grid <- plot_grid(plotlist=plot_matrix, ncol=length(col_order), align="hv")
with_top <- plot_grid(plot_grid(plotlist=top_labels, ncol=length(col_order)), panel_grid, ncol=1, rel_heights=c(0.06,1))
final <- plot_grid(plot_grid(plotlist=left_labels, ncol=1), with_top, ncol=2, rel_widths=c(0.08,1))

# SAVE
ggsave("FigureS2.pdf", final, width=8, height=12, units="in", dpi=300)

```


#Figure S3:

```{r}
#1kg 

#Figure S3

qpadm_path <- "../final_sup_figures_data/qpadm_individual_CEU.txt"

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)

# Base directory
base_path <- "../final_sup_figures_data"

# Dataset file names
dataset_files <- c(
  "1kg_ancestryhmm_output_global_ancestry.txt",
  "1kg_rfmix_output_global_ancestry.txt",
  "1kg_mosaic_output_global_ancestry.txt",
  "1kg_simplai_output_global_ancestry.txt"
)

# Full dataset paths
dataset_paths <- file.path(base_path, dataset_files)

# Extract method names from first part of filename
dataset_names <- gsub("_output_global_ancestry.txt", "", dataset_files)


# Function to read and rename
read_and_process <- function(file_path, method_name) {
  df <- read.table(file_path, header = TRUE)
  colnames(df) <- c("sample", paste0("global_ancestry_", method_name))
  return(df)
}

# Read LAI datasets
dataset_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(dataset_paths)) {
  dataset_list[[i]] <- read_and_process(dataset_paths[i], dataset_names[i])
}

# Read qpAdm separately
qpadm_df <- read_and_process(qpadm_path, "qpadm")

# Combine everything
combined_df <- reduce(c(dataset_list, list(qpadm_df)), 
                      function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "sample"))

# Keep only relevant columns
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  select(sample, starts_with("global_ancestry_"))

# Remove NAs
combined_df <- na.omit(combined_df)

# Plot settings
base_font_size <- 10
plots <- list()

qpAdm_vals <- combined_df[["global_ancestry_qpadm"]]

for (method in dataset_names) {
  
  y_vals <- combined_df[[paste0("global_ancestry_", method)]]
  df_plot <- data.frame(qpadm = qpAdm_vals, method_val = y_vals)

  r_val <- cor(df_plot$qpadm, df_plot$method_val)
  delta_val <- mean(abs(df_plot$method_val - df_plot$qpadm))
  
  fit <- lm(method_val ~ qpadm, data = df_plot)
  beta_val <- coef(fit)[2]

  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = qpadm, y = method_val)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, color = "steelblue", size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "firebrick", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", 
                color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.00, y = 0.60,
             label = bquote(R == .(round(r_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.00, y = 0.50,
             label = bquote(beta == .(round(beta_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.30, y = 0.10,
             label = bquote(Delta == .(round(delta_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    labs(
      x = "qpAdm",
      y = "Global Ancestry",
      title = method
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_font_size) +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", 
                                size = base_font_size + 1, 
                                hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_font_size + 2),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_font_size, color = "black"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.45), ylim = c(0, 0.7))

  plots[[length(plots) + 1]] <- p
}

# Combine panels
final_plot <- plot_grid(plotlist = plots, ncol = 2)

# Save as Figure_S3
ggsave("FigureS3.pdf", final_plot, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

#Figure S4:

```{r}

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)


# Helper function

read_file <- function(path, colname, remove_rnd = FALSE) {
  df <- read.table(path, header = TRUE)
  
  # Standardize column names
  colnames(df) <- c("sample", colname)
  
  # Remove _rnd if needed
  if (remove_rnd) {
    df$sample <- gsub("_rnd$", "", df$sample)
  }
  
  return(df)
}


# Read datasets

# ADMIXTURE
admix_imp   <- read_file("../final_sup_figures_data/admixture_imputed.txt", "imputed")
admix_unimp <- read_file("../final_sup_figures_data/admixture_unimputed.txt", "unimputed", remove_rnd = TRUE)
admix_df <- inner_join(admix_unimp, admix_imp, by = "sample")
# qpAdm
qpadm_imp   <- read_file("../final_sup_figures_data/qpadm_imputed.txt", "imputed")
qpadm_unimp <- read_file("../final_sup_figures_data/qpadm_unimputed.txt", "unimputed", remove_rnd = TRUE)
qpadm_df <- inner_join(qpadm_unimp, qpadm_imp, by = "sample")
# AncestryHMM
ahmm_imp   <- read_file("../final_sup_figures_data/ancestry_hmm_output_global_ancestry.txt", "imputed")
ahmm_unimp <- read_file("../final_sup_figures_data/ancestry_hmm_unimputed_full.txt", "unimputed", remove_rnd = TRUE)

ahmm_df <- inner_join(ahmm_unimp, ahmm_imp, by = "sample")


# Plotting function

make_plot <- function(df, title_label) {
  
  r_val <- cor(df$unimputed, df$imputed)
  delta_val <- mean(abs(df$imputed - df$unimputed))
  fit <- lm(imputed ~ unimputed, data = df)
  beta_val <- coef(fit)[2]
  
  mean_unimp <- mean(df$unimputed)
  mean_imp   <- mean(df$imputed)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = unimputed, y = imputed)) +
    geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "firebrick",
                se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.00, y = 0.60,
             label = bquote(R == .(round(r_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.00, y = 0.50,
             label = bquote(beta == .(round(beta_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.30, y = 0.10,
             label = bquote(Delta == .(round(delta_val, 3))),
             hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
         x = 0.00, y = 0.67,
         label = bquote(bar(U) == .(round(mean_unimp, 3)) ~ "," ~ 
                        bar(I) == .(round(mean_imp, 3))),
         hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    labs(
      x = "Unimputed",
      y = "Imputed",
      title = title_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.45), ylim = c(0, 0.7))
}


# Generate plots

p1 <- make_plot(admix_df, "ADMIXTURE")
p2 <- make_plot(qpadm_df, "qpAdm")
p3 <- make_plot(ahmm_df, "AncestryHMM")

final_plot <- plot_grid(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 3)

ggsave("FigureS4.pdf",
       final_plot,
       width = 6.5,
       height = 3,
       dpi = 300)

```

#Figure S5:


```{r}
# LOAD LIBRARIES
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

# FILE PATHS 

sex_file <- "../final_sup_figures_data/sex_ploidy.txt"

method_files <- c(
  "../final_sup_figures_data/chr_x_admixture.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/chr_x_ancestryhmm.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/chr_x_mosaic.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/chr_x_simplai.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/chr_x_rfmix.txt"
)
# READ SEX FILE
sex_df <- read.table(sex_file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(sex_df) <- c("sample", "ploidy", "ancestry_ref")

sex_df <- sex_df %>%
  mutate(
    sex = factor(ploidy, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Male", "Female"))
  )

# READ METHOD FILES
read_method <- function(file) {
  method_name <- file %>%
    basename() %>%
    gsub("^chr_x_", "", .) %>%
    gsub("\\.txt$", "", .)

  df <- read.table(file, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(df) <- c("sample", "prop")

  df %>%
    mutate(method = method_name)
}

method_df <- map_dfr(method_files, read_method)

# ADD QPADM
qpadm_df <- read.table(
  "../final_sup_figures_data/x_qpadm_global.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
colnames(qpadm_df) <- c("sample", "prop")

qpadm_df <- qpadm_df %>%
  mutate(method = "X_qpadm")

method_df <- bind_rows(method_df, qpadm_df)

# MERGE WITH SEX
combined_df <- method_df %>%
  inner_join(sex_df %>% select(sample, sex), by = "sample")

# T-TESTS PER METHOD
ttest_df <- combined_df %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch(
      t.test(prop ~ sex)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = ifelse(is.na(p_value),
                     "p = NA",
                     paste0("p = ", signif(p_value, 3)))
  )

combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  left_join(ttest_df, by = "method")

# PLOTTING FUNCTION
plot_methods <- function(df, output_file) {

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = sex, y = prop, color = sex)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~ method, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Male" = "steelblue",
                                  "Female" = "orange")) +
    geom_text(
      data = distinct(df, method, p_label),
      aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = p_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = 1.2,
      size = 3.2
    ) +

}
```

```{r}
# LOAD LIBRARIES
library(tidyverse)


# FILE PATHS 

base_path <- "../final_sup_figures_data/"

inputs <- c(
  paste0(base_path, "rfmix_chr23_sex_tracts_by_sex_and_ancestry.txt"),
  paste0(base_path, "simplai_chr23_sex_tracts_by_sex_and_ancestry.txt"),
  paste0(base_path, "mosaic_chr23_sex_tracts_by_sex_and_ancestry.txt"),
  paste0(base_path, "ancestryhmm_chr23_sex_tracts_by_sex_and_ancestry.txt")
)

labels <- c("RFMix", "simpLAI", "Mosaic", "Ancestry HMM")


# SETTINGS

ancestry_labels <- list(
  "1" = list(name = "Farmer", color = "tab:blue"),
  "2" = list(name = "Hunter-gatherer", color = "tab:red")
)


# HELPERS

load_tracts <- function(path, ancestry) {
  df <- read.table(path, header = TRUE)

  df <- df %>% filter(ancestry == !!ancestry)

  males <- df %>%
    filter(sex == "male") %>%
    pull(tract_length_cm)

  females <- df %>%
    filter(sex == "female") %>%
    pull(tract_length_cm)

  # Optional filter (currently OFF, matches your Python script)
  # males <- males[males >= 1]
  # females <- females[females >= 1]

  list(males = males, females = females)
}

qq_points <- function(x, y, min_n = 10, num_points = 100) {

  x <- log10(x[x > 0])
  y <- log10(y[y > 0])

  if (length(x) < min_n || length(y) < min_n) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  percentiles <- seq(0, 1, length.out = num_points + 2)[-c(1, num_points + 2)]

  xq <- quantile(x, percentiles, na.rm = TRUE)
  yq <- quantile(y, percentiles, na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(x = xq, y = yq)
}


# BUILD DATA FOR PLOTTING

plot_data <- map2_dfr(inputs, labels, function(path, label) {

  map_dfr(c(1, 2), function(anc) {

    tracts <- load_tracts(path, anc)
    qq <- qq_points(tracts$males, tracts$females)

    if (is.null(qq)) return(NULL)

    tibble(
      method = label,
      ancestry = ancestry_labels[[as.character(anc)]]$name,
      color = ancestry_labels[[as.character(anc)]]$color,
      x = qq$x,
      y = qq$y
    )
  })
})


# GET GLOBAL LIMITS FOR DIAGONAL

lims <- range(c(plot_data$x, plot_data$y), na.rm = TRUE)


# PLOT

p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = ancestry)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ method, ncol = 2, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Farmer" = "#1f77b4",
    "Hunter-gatherer" = "#d62728"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "Male log10 tract length (cM)",
    y = "Female log10 tract length (cM)",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )


# SAVE
ggsave("FigureS6.pdf", p, width = 4.5, height = 4.5)
```

#Figure S8:


```{r}

hg_tracts <- read.table("../final_sup_figures_data/chrx_hg_combined_tract_data.txt", header = TRUE)
farmer_tracts <- read.table("../final_sup_figures_data/chrx_farmer_combined_tract_data.txt", header = TRUE)


# Combined analysis for both populations
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(patchwork)  # Add this library for better plot combining

# Function to create plot data for a given population
create_plot_data <- function(pop_data, pop_name) {
  # Log-spaced bins from 1 to 1000 cM
  bin_edges <- 10^seq(log10(0.5), log10(1000), length.out = 60)
  
  # Filter out zeros and negative (tract length must be >0 for log binning)
  filtered_data <- pop_data %>%
    filter(tract_length_cm > 0)
  
  # Assign each tract to a bin
  filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
    mutate(bin = cut(tract_length_cm, breaks = bin_edges, include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE))
  
  # Create a lookup table for bin centers
  bin_centers <- data.frame(
    bin = levels(cut(1, breaks = bin_edges, include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)),
    bin_start = bin_edges[-length(bin_edges)],
    bin_end = bin_edges[-1]
  ) %>%
    mutate(bin_center = (bin_start + bin_end) / 2)
  
  # Population proportions
  p_farmer <- 0.6
  p_hg <- 0.4
  
  # Summarize counts per Source and bin
  binned_summary <- filtered_data %>%
    group_by(Source, bin) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    left_join(bin_centers, by = "bin") %>%
    filter(!is.na(bin_center))
  
  # Calculate total tracts per Source for empirical datasets
  total_counts_per_source <- binned_summary %>%
    group_by(Source) %>%
    summarise(total_count = sum(count))
  
  # Add proportion column for empirical data
  binned_summary <- binned_summary %>%
    left_join(total_counts_per_source, by = "Source") %>%
    mutate(proportion = count / total_count)
  
  # Define scaling factor based on population proportion
  p_pop <- ifelse(pop_name == "hg", p_hg, 
                  ifelse(pop_name == "farmer", p_farmer, NA))
  
  if (is.na(p_pop)) {
    stop("Population must be 'hg' or 'farmer' for theoretical scaling.")
  }
  
  # Generate continuous theoretical curves
  T_values <- seq(10, 200, by = 5)  # More continuous T values
  
  theoretical_data <- data.frame()
  
  # Define cutoff probability and calculate corresponding x-value for each T
  cutoff_prob <- 1e-5
  
  for (T in T_values) {
    lambda_rate <- (T * (1 - p_pop)) / 100
    
    # Calculate x-value where probability drops to cutoff_prob
    # For exponential: prob = exp(-lambda * x), so x = -log(prob) / lambda
    cutoff_x <- -log(cutoff_prob) / lambda_rate
    
    # Filter bin_centers to only include those up to cutoff_x
    filtered_bins <- bin_centers %>%
      filter(bin_center <= cutoff_x)
    
    # Add the exact cutoff point
    if(nrow(filtered_bins) > 0) {
      theory_bin_data <- filtered_bins %>%
        mutate(
          bin_probability = (exp(-lambda_rate * bin_start) - exp(-lambda_rate * bin_end)),
          Source = paste0("Theory T=", T),
          T_value = T
        )
      
      # Add the exact cutoff point
      cutoff_point <- data.frame(
        bin = NA,
        bin_start = cutoff_x,
        bin_end = cutoff_x,
        bin_center = cutoff_x,
        bin_probability = cutoff_prob,
        Source = paste0("Theory T=", T),
        T_value = T
      )
      
      theory_bin_data <- rbind(theory_bin_data, cutoff_point)
      theoretical_data <- rbind(theoretical_data, theory_bin_data)
    }
  }
  
  # Rename methods for colors
  change_color_names <- c(
    "rfmix" = "rfmix",
    "ancestry_paths" = "ancestry_paths",
    "ancestry_hmm_haplotypes" = "ancestry_hmm",
    "simplai" = "simplai",
    "mosaic" = "mosaic"
  )
  
  binned_summary$Source <- sapply(binned_summary$Source, function(x) {
    if (x %in% names(change_color_names)) {
      change_color_names[[x]]
    } else {
      x
    }
  })
  
  # Combine empirical and theoretical data
  empirical_data <- binned_summary %>% 
    select(Source, bin_center, proportion) %>% 
    rename(value = proportion) %>%
    mutate(type = "empirical")
  
  theoretical_plot_data <- theoretical_data %>% 
    select(Source, bin_center, bin_probability, T_value) %>% 
    rename(value = bin_probability) %>%
    mutate(type = "theoretical")
  
  # Filter theoretical data to only keep points with value >= 1e-5 (cutoff just below 0.00001)
  theoretical_plot_data <- theoretical_plot_data %>%
    filter(value >= 1e-5)
  
  list(empirical = empirical_data, theoretical = theoretical_plot_data)
}

# Create plot function
create_individual_plot <- function(plot_data_list, pop_name, y_limits, x_limits, show_x_title = TRUE, show_title = TRUE, point_shape = 16) {
  empirical_data <- plot_data_list$empirical
  theoretical_data <- plot_data_list$theoretical
  
  # Method names for labeling
  method_names <- c(
    "rfmix" = "RFMix",
    "ancestry_paths" = "Ancestry Paths", 
    "ancestry_hmm" = "Ancestry HMM",
    "simplai" = "SimpLAI",
    "mosaic" = "Mosaic"
  )
  
  # Get empirical sources
  empirical_sources <- unique(empirical_data$Source)
  
  # Create base plot
  x_title <- if(show_x_title) "Tract Length (cM)" else ""
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Add theoretical curves for selected T values
    geom_line(data = theoretical_data %>% filter(T_value %in% c(10, 20, 50, 100, 200)),
              aes(x = bin_center, y = value, group = T_value),
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.8) +
    
    # Add empirical data points
    geom_point(data = empirical_data, 
               aes(x = bin_center, y = value, color = Source),
               shape = point_shape,
               alpha = 0.8, size = 1) +
    
    scale_x_log10(name = x_title, 
                  limits = x_limits,  # Use consistent x limits
                  breaks = c(1, 5, 20, 100, 500),
                  labels = c("1", "5", "20", "100", "500")) +
    scale_y_log10(name = "Proportion", 
                  limits = y_limits,
                  labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.00001, trim = TRUE)) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = colors[empirical_sources]) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 1, r = 15, b = -1, l = 3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Add T value labels at the end of each curve (find the maximum x for each T line)
  theory_label_data <- theoretical_data %>%
    filter(T_value %in% c(10, 20, 50, 100, 200)) %>%
    group_by(T_value) %>%
    filter(bin_center == max(bin_center)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
# ---- T labels (smaller text) ----
p <- p + geom_text(
  data = theory_label_data,
  aes(x = bin_center, y = value, label = paste0("T=", T_value)),
  hjust = -0.05,
  vjust = 0.5,
  size = 1.8,
  color = "black"
)

# ---- Method labels (SimpLAI moved down) ----
method_label_data <- empirical_data %>%
  group_by(Source) %>%
  filter(bin_center == max(bin_center)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    method_label = method_names[Source],
    vshift = ifelse(Source == "simplai", 0.00005, 0)  # move only SimpLAI down
  )

p <- p + geom_text(
  data = method_label_data,
  aes(
    x = bin_center,
    y = value + vshift,
    label = method_label,
    color = Source
  ),
  hjust = -0.05,
  vjust = 0.5,
  size = 2.3,
  show.legend = FALSE
)
  
  # Add panel label only if requested
  if(show_title) {
    panel_label <- ifelse(pop_name == "hg", "Hunter-Gatherer", "Farmer")
    p <- p + ggtitle(panel_label) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 7, face = "bold"))
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# Process both populations
hg_plot_data <- create_plot_data(hg_tracts, "hg")
farmer_plot_data <- create_plot_data(farmer_tracts, "farmer")

# Determine common y-axis and x-axis limits
all_empirical_values <- c(hg_plot_data$empirical$value, farmer_plot_data$empirical$value)
all_theoretical_values <- c(hg_plot_data$theoretical$value, farmer_plot_data$theoretical$value)
all_values <- c(all_empirical_values, all_theoretical_values)

# Set consistent limits
y_limits <- c(min(all_values) * 0.9, max(all_values) * 1.2)

# Get x-axis limits from both datasets
all_x_values <- c(hg_plot_data$empirical$bin_center, farmer_plot_data$empirical$bin_center,
                  hg_plot_data$theoretical$bin_center, farmer_plot_data$theoretical$bin_center)
x_limits <- c(min(all_x_values) * 0.9, max(all_x_values) * 1.1)

# Create individual plots with consistent limits
p_hg <- create_individual_plot(hg_plot_data, "hg", y_limits, x_limits, 
                              show_x_title = FALSE, show_title = FALSE, point_shape = 17)  # Triangle
p_farmer <- create_individual_plot(farmer_plot_data, "farmer", y_limits, x_limits, 
                                  show_x_title = TRUE, show_title = FALSE, point_shape = 15)  # Square

# Combine plots using patchwork
combined_plot <- p_hg / p_farmer
combined_plot <- combined_plot + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation() &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 2, 0.3, 2))

# Save the plot
ggsave("FigureS8.pdf", combined_plot, width = 3.5, height = 4)

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

  
# INPUT FILES
  

discovery_file <- "../final_sup_figures_data/x_dis_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt"
replication_file <- "../final_sup_figures_data/x_rep_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt"

regions <- matrix(
  c(
    23, 51308981,
    23, 97945412
  ),
  ncol = 2,
  byrow = TRUE
)
colnames(regions) <- c("CHR", "POS")

window_size <- 10e6

  
# LOAD DATA (SAFE SELECT FIX)
  

z_score_data <- read.table(discovery_file, header = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(CHR, POS, weighted_z)

rep_z_score_data <- read.table(replication_file, header = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(CHR, POS, weighted_z)

  
# PLOT FUNCTION
  

make_chr_plot <- function(chrom, midpoint, show_legend = FALSE) {

  rep_subset <- rep_z_score_data %>%
    filter(CHR == chrom,
           POS >= (midpoint - window_size),
           POS <= (midpoint + window_size)) %>%
    mutate(dataset = "Replication")

  disc_subset <- z_score_data %>%
    filter(CHR == chrom,
           POS >= (midpoint - window_size),
           POS <= (midpoint + window_size)) %>%
    mutate(dataset = "Discovery")

  combined <- bind_rows(rep_subset, disc_subset)

  if (nrow(combined) == 0) {
    stop(paste0("No data for Chr ", chrom, " at ", midpoint))
  }

  combined <- combined %>%
    mutate(POS_MB = POS / 1e6)

  p <- ggplot(combined, aes(x = POS_MB, y = weighted_z, color = dataset)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +

    geom_hline(yintercept = c(3, -3),
               color = "black",
               linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(1.96, -1.96),
               linetype = "dashed",
               color = "black",
               linewidth = 0.4) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        Discovery = "purple4",
        Replication = "#56B4E9"
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0("Chr ", chrom, " (", round(midpoint/1e6, 2), " Mb)"),
      x = "Position (Mb)",
      y = "Z-score",
      color = NULL
    ) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "bottom" else "none"
    )

  return(p)
}

  
# BUILD PLOTS
  

plot_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(regions)), function(i) {
  make_chr_plot(regions[i,1], regions[i,2], show_legend = FALSE)
})

# ---- Extract SINGLE legend from first plot ----
legend_plot <- make_chr_plot(regions[1,1], regions[1,2], show_legend = TRUE)
legend <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)

# Ensure no duplicate legend anywhere
plot_list <- lapply(plot_list, function(p) p + theme(legend.position = "none"))

  
# PANEL LAYOUT
  

n_plots <- length(plot_list)
ncol <- ceiling(sqrt(n_plots))

panel <- plot_grid(
  plotlist = plot_list,
  ncol = ncol,
  labels = LETTERS[1:n_plots],
  label_size = 10
)

  
# FINAL COMBINATION (single legend only)

  panel,
  legend,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.12)
)

  
# SAVE
  

ggsave(
  "FigureS9.pdf",
  final_plot,
  width = 6,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)


# FILES

dataset_paths <- c(
  "../final_sup_figures_data/ancestry_hmm_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/rfmix_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/simplai_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/mosaic_average_ancestry_output.txt"
)

dataset_names <- c(
  "ancestry_hmm",
  "rfmix",
  "simplai",
  "mosaic"
)

num_datasets <- length(dataset_paths)

# regions (same as your CLI)
regions <- matrix(
  c(
    23, 51308981,
    23, 97945412
  ),
  ncol = 2,
  byrow = TRUE
)
colnames(regions) <- c("CHR", "POS")


# COLORS

method_colors <- c(
  rfmix = "#d62728",
  ancestry_hmm = "#1f77b4",
  simplai = "#e377c2",
  mosaic = "#2ca02c"
)


# READ DATA

compute_zscore <- function(data) {
  data$new_z <- as.numeric(scale(data$HGall))
  data
}

read_dataset <- function(path, name) {

  df <- read.table(path, header = TRUE)
  colnames(df) <- c("CHR", "POS", "HGall")

  df <- df[order(df$CHR, df$POS), ]

  window_size <- 51
  out <- list()

  for (chr in unique(df$CHR)) {

    chr_data <- df[df$CHR == chr, ]
    n <- nrow(chr_data)

    means <- sapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
      end <- min(i + window_size - 1, n)
      mean(chr_data$HGall[i:end], na.rm = TRUE)
    })

    out[[as.character(chr)]] <- data.frame(
      CHR = chr_data$CHR,
      POS = chr_data$POS,
      HGall = means,
      dataset = name
    )
  }

  out <- bind_rows(out)
  compute_zscore(out)
}

full_dataset <- bind_rows(
  lapply(seq_along(dataset_paths), function(i) {
    read_dataset(dataset_paths[i], dataset_names[i])
  })
)


# PLOT FUNCTION

make_region_plot <- function(chrom, midpoint) {

  window_size <- 10e6

  region_data <- full_dataset %>%
    filter(
      CHR == chrom &
        POS >= (midpoint - window_size) &
        POS <= (midpoint + window_size)
    )

  region_data$POS_MB <- region_data$POS / 1e6

  p <- ggplot(region_data,
              aes(x = POS_MB, y = new_z, color = dataset)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(3, -3), color = "black") +
    scale_color_manual(values = method_colors) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Chr ", chrom, " (", round(midpoint/1e6, 2), " Mb)"),
      x = "Position (Mb)",
      y = "Z-score"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 8)
    )

  # gene box (same logic)
  if (chrom == 6) {
    xmin <- 29.6
    xmax <- 33.4
    ymin <- -3.2
    ymax <- -2.8
  } else {
    xmin <- (midpoint / 1e6) - 0.2
    xmax <- (midpoint / 1e6) + 0.2
    ymin <- -3.2
    ymax <- -2.8
  }

  p + annotate("rect",
               xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
               ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
               fill = "black")
}


# BUILD PLOTS

plot_list <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(regions)),
  function(i) make_region_plot(regions[i,1], regions[i,2])
)

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  make_region_plot(regions[1,1], regions[1,2]) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
)

panel <- plot_grid(
  plotlist = plot_list,
  ncol = ceiling(sqrt(length(plot_list))),
  labels = LETTERS[1:length(plot_list)],
  label_size = 9
)

final_plot <- plot_grid(
  panel,
  legend,
  rel_widths = c(1, 0.25)
)

ggsave("FigureS10.pdf",
       final_plot,
       width = 6,
       height = 6,
       dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
  data
}

  
# READ DATA (UNCHANGED LOGIC, SAFE)
  

read_dataset <- function(path, name) {

  df <- read.table(path, header = TRUE)
  colnames(df) <- c("CHR", "POS", "HGall")

  df <- df[order(df$CHR, df$POS), ]

  window_size <- 51
  out <- list()

  for (chr in unique(df$CHR)) {

    chr_data <- df[df$CHR == chr, ]
    n <- nrow(chr_data)

    means <- sapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
      end <- min(i + window_size - 1, n)
      mean(chr_data$HGall[i:end], na.rm = TRUE)
    })

    out[[as.character(chr)]] <- data.frame(
      CHR = chr_data$CHR,
      POS = chr_data$POS,
      HGall = means,
      dataset = name
    )
  }

  out <- bind_rows(out)
  compute_zscore(out)
}

  
# LOAD ALL DATASETS
  

full_dataset <- bind_rows(
  lapply(seq_along(dataset_paths), function(i) {
    read_dataset(dataset_paths[i], dataset_names[i])
  })
)

  
# PLOT FUNCTION
  

make_region_plot <- function(chrom, midpoint) {

  window_size <- 10e6

  region_data <- full_dataset %>%
    filter(
      CHR == chrom,
      POS >= (midpoint - window_size),
      POS <= (midpoint + window_size)
    ) %>%
    mutate(POS_MB = POS / 1e6)

  ggplot(region_data,
         aes(x = POS_MB, y = new_z, color = dataset)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(3, -3), color = "black") +

    scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, drop = FALSE) +

    labs(
      title = paste0("Chr ", chrom, " (", round(midpoint/1e6, 2), " Mb)"),
      x = "Position (Mb)",
      y = "Z-score",
      color = NULL
    ) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 8)
    ) +

    # gene box logic
    {
      if (chrom == 6) {
        ann <- data.frame(
          start = 29600000,
          end = 33400000
        )
        xmin <- ann$start / 1e6
        xmax <- ann$end / 1e6
        ymin <- -3.2
        ymax <- -2.8
      } else {
        xmin <- (midpoint / 1e6) - 0.2
        xmax <- (midpoint / 1e6) + 0.2
        ymin <- -3.2
        ymax <- -2.8
      }

      annotate("rect",
               xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
               ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
               fill = "black")
    }
}

  
# BUILD PLOTS
  

plot_list <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(regions)),
  function(i) make_region_plot(regions[i,1], regions[i,2])
)

  
# LEGEND (SINGLE CLEAN KEY)
  

legend_plot <- make_region_plot(regions[1,1], regions[1,2])

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  legend_plot +
    guides(color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 3)
    )) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm")
    )
)

# remove legends everywhere else
plot_list <- lapply(plot_list, function(p) p + theme(legend.position = "none"))

  
# PANEL LAYOUT
  

n_plots <- length(plot_list)
ncol_layout <- ceiling(sqrt(n_plots))

panel <- plot_grid(
  plotlist = plot_list,
  ncol = ncol_layout,
  labels = LETTERS[1:n_plots],
  label_size = 9
)

  
# FINAL FIGURE
  

final_plot <- plot_grid(
  panel,
  legend,
  ncol = 2,
  rel_widths = c(1, 0.25)
)

  
# SAVE FIGURE S11
  

ggsave(
  "FigureS11.pdf",
  final_plot,
  width = 6,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
z_score_data <- read.table("../final_sup_figures_data/S13_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt", header = TRUE)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)

# Read data
combined_data <- z_score_data

# Assign alternating purple shades per chromosome
combined_data$color <- ifelse(as.numeric(combined_data$CHR) %% 2 == 0, "#9b59b6", "#d2b4de")  # dark and light purple


# Get average index per chromosome
chr_positions <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(CHR) %>%
  summarise(chr_index = mean(index)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Gene label positions (x = previous chromosome, y = ±4)
gene_labels <- data.frame(
  gene = c("HLA", "FADS", "SLC24A5", "TMEM117"),
  CHR = c(6, 11, 14, 11),
  y = c(4, -3.7, -3.7, 4)
) %>%
  left_join(chr_positions, by = "CHR") %>%
  # Shift to previous chromosome’s index if possible
  mutate(CHR_prev = CHR - 1) %>%
  left_join(chr_positions, by = c("CHR_prev" = "CHR"), suffix = c("", "_prev")) %>%
  mutate(x = ifelse(!is.na(chr_index_prev), chr_index_prev, chr_index)) %>%
  select(gene, x, y)



# Create Manhattan plot
manhattan_plot <- ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = index, y = weighted_z, color = color)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(3, -3), color = "black", linetype = "solid") +


  # Add line labels (using annotate)
  annotate("text", x = max(combined_data$index) * 0.98, y = 3, label = "Z = 3", hjust = 1, vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +

  annotate("text", x = max(combined_data$index) * 0.98, y = -3, label = "Z = -3", hjust = 1, vjust = 1.3, size = 3) +


  
    # Gene annotations
 # geom_text(data = gene_labels, aes(x = x, y = y, label = gene), 
  #          inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.2, fontface = "italic", vjust = ifelse(gene_labels$y > 0, -0.3, 1.3)) +

  
  
  scale_color_identity() +
  labs(x = "Chromosome", y = "Average Z-score") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

# Prepare data for QQ plot
qq_data <- combined_data %>%
  dplyr::select(p_value = p_value) %>%
  mutate(p_value = as.numeric(p_value)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_value) & p_value > 0)

# Create QQ plot
qq_plot <- {
  n <- length(qq_data$p_value)
  observed <- -log10(sort(qq_data$p_value))
  expected <- -log10(ppoints(n))
  
  ggplot(data.frame(expected, observed), aes(x = expected, y = observed)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "gray40", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(x = "Expected", y = "Observed") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )
}

# Combine plots side by side using cowplot
combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  manhattan_plot,
  qq_plot,
  labels = c("A", "B"),
  label_size = 12,
  rel_widths = c(2.5, 1.5)
)

# Save to PDF
ggsave("FigureS13.pdf", combined_plot, width = 8, height = 3.75)
```

#Supplementary Tables:

#Table S1:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

  
# 0. Load data
  

# Discovery dataset
z_score_data <- read.table("../final_figures_data/dis_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt", header = TRUE)

# replication datasets
rep_z_score_data <- read.table("../final_figures_data/rep2_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt", header = TRUE)
capture_z_score_data <- read.table("../final_figures_data/rep1_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt", header = TRUE)


  
# 1. Keep autosomes only
  

z_score_data <- z_score_data %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)
rep_z_score_data <- rep_z_score_data %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)
capture_z_score_data <- capture_z_score_data %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)

  
# 2. Filter |Z| > 3 in discovery
  

discovery_hits <- z_score_data %>%
  filter(abs(weighted_z) > 3) %>%
  arrange(CHR, POS)

  
# 3. Collapse regions within 3 Mb
  

collapse_hits <- function(df, window = 3e6) {
  
  df <- df %>% arrange(CHR, POS)
  kept <- list()
  
  for(chr in unique(df$CHR)) {
    
    chr_df <- df %>% filter(CHR == chr)
    
    while(nrow(chr_df) > 0) {
      
      lead <- chr_df[1, ]
      
      region <- chr_df %>%
        filter(abs(POS - lead$POS) <= window)
      
      # Keep lowest p-value
      best <- region %>% arrange(p_value) %>% slice(1)
      
      kept[[length(kept) + 1]] <- best
      
      chr_df <- chr_df %>%
        filter(abs(POS - best$POS) > window)
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(kept)
}

discovery_collapsed <- collapse_hits(discovery_hits, window = 3e6)

  
# 4. Replication function (2 Mb window ONLY)
  

find_replication <- function(row, rep_df, window = 2e6, p_thresh = 0.005) {
  
  chr <- row$CHR
  pos <- row$POS
  
  chr_rep <- rep_df %>% filter(CHR == chr)
  
  hits <- chr_rep %>% filter(abs(POS - pos) <= window)
  
  if(nrow(hits) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  best <- hits %>% arrange(p_value) %>% slice(1)
  
  tibble(
    Replication_POS = best$POS,
    Replication_Z = best$weighted_z,
    Replication_P = best$p_value,
    Distance_bp = abs(best$POS - pos),
    Replication_Significant = best$p_value < p_thresh,
    Any_Significant_2Mb = any(hits$p_value < p_thresh)
  )
}

  
# 5. Build final table (Akbari + Capture)
  

results <- list()

for(i in 1:nrow(discovery_collapsed)) {
  
  disc <- discovery_collapsed[i, ]
  
  # Akbari replication
  rep_akbari <- find_replication(disc, rep_z_score_data)
  
  # Capture replication
  rep_capture <- find_replication(disc, capture_z_score_data)
  
  if(!is.null(rep_akbari) | !is.null(rep_capture)) {
    
    if(!is.null(rep_akbari)){
      rep_akbari <- rep_akbari %>%
        rename_with(~paste0("Akbari_", .))
    }
    
    if(!is.null(rep_capture)){
      rep_capture <- rep_capture %>%
        rename_with(~paste0("Capture_", .))
    }
    
    combined <- bind_cols(
      tibble(
        CHR = disc$CHR,
        Discovery_POS = disc$POS,
        Discovery_Z = disc$weighted_z,
        Discovery_P = disc$p_value
      ),
      rep_akbari,
      rep_capture
    )
    
    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- combined
  }
}

final_table <- bind_rows(results)

  
# 6. Optional summary column
  

final_table <- final_table %>%
  mutate(
    Replicated_in_any = coalesce(Akbari_Replication_Significant, FALSE) |
                        coalesce(Capture_Replication_Significant, FALSE)
  )

  
# 7. Save table
  


final_table_clean <- final_table %>%
  transmute(
    CHR,
    
    # Discovery
    Discovery_POS,
    Discovery_Z,
    Discovery_P,
    
        # Rep1 (formerly Capture)
    Rep1_Z = Capture_Replication_Z,
    Rep1_P = Capture_Replication_P,
    Replicated_Rep1 = coalesce(Capture_Replication_Significant, FALSE),
    
    # Rep2 (formerly Akbari)
    Rep2_Z = Akbari_Replication_Z,
    Rep2_P = Akbari_Replication_P,
    Replicated_Rep2 = coalesce(Akbari_Replication_Significant, FALSE)
    
  )

write.table(final_table_clean,
            "Table_S1.txt",
            quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE,
            sep = "\t")

```


#Table S2:

#Table S3:

```{r}

#table S3

#X chromosome and replication 

#Hits reaching a threshold of Z is greater than 3 or less than -3 on the X 

library(tidyverse)

# Load data
z_score_data <- read.table(
  "../final_sup_figures_data/x_dis_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt",
  header = TRUE
)

rep_z_score_data <- read.table(
  "../final_sup_figures_data/x_rep_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt",
  header = TRUE
)

 
# 1. Keep autosomes only
 

#z_score_data <- z_score_data %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)
#rep_z_score_data <- rep_z_score_data %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)

 
# 2. Filter |Z| > 3 in discovery
 

discovery_hits <- z_score_data %>%
  filter(abs(weighted_z) > 3) %>%
  arrange(CHR, POS)

 
# 3. Collapse regions within 3 Mb
 

collapse_hits <- function(df, window = 3e6) {
  
  df <- df %>% arrange(CHR, POS)
  kept <- list()
  
  for(chr in unique(df$CHR)) {
    
    chr_df <- df %>% filter(CHR == chr)
    
    while(nrow(chr_df) > 0) {
      
      lead <- chr_df[1, ]
      
      region <- chr_df %>%
        filter(abs(POS - lead$POS) <= window)
      
      # Keep lowest p-value
      best <- region %>% arrange(p_value) %>% slice(1)
      
      kept[[length(kept) + 1]] <- best
      
      chr_df <- chr_df %>%
        filter(abs(POS - best$POS) > window)
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(kept)
}

discovery_collapsed <- collapse_hits(discovery_hits, window = 3e6)

 
# 4. Find replication matches
 

find_replication <- function(row, rep_df, strict_window = 250000, broad_window = 2000000, p_thresh = 0.005) {
  
  chr <- row$CHR
  pos <- row$POS
  
  chr_rep <- rep_df %>% filter(CHR == chr)
  
  # Compute both windows first
  tight <- chr_rep %>% filter(abs(POS - pos) <= strict_window)
  loose <- chr_rep %>% filter(abs(POS - pos) <= broad_window)
  
  # Choose best hit
  if(nrow(tight) > 0) {
    best <- tight %>% arrange(p_value) %>% slice(1)
    window_type <- "250kb"
  } else if(nrow(loose) > 0) {
    best <- loose %>% arrange(p_value) %>% slice(1)
    window_type <- "2Mb"
  } else {
    return(NULL) # no replication hit found
  }
  
  distance_bp <- abs(best$POS - pos)
  
  # Check if any replication hit in windows has p < threshold
  sig_250kb <- any(tight$p_value < p_thresh)
  sig_2Mb   <- any(loose$p_value < p_thresh)
  
  tibble(
    Replication_POS = best$POS,
    Replication_Z = best$weighted_z,
    Replication_P = best$p_value,
    Distance_bp = distance_bp,
    Replication_Significant = best$p_value < p_thresh,
    Significant_250kb = sig_250kb,
    Significant_2Mb = sig_2Mb,
    Replication_Window = window_type
  )
}
 
# 5. Build final table
 

results <- list()

for(i in 1:nrow(discovery_collapsed)) {
  
  disc <- discovery_collapsed[i, ]
  rep_hit <- find_replication(disc, rep_z_score_data)
  
  if(!is.null(rep_hit)) {
    
    combined <- bind_cols(
      tibble(
        CHR = disc$CHR,
        Discovery_POS = disc$POS,
        Discovery_Z = disc$weighted_z,
        Discovery_P = disc$p_value
      ),
      rep_hit
    )
    
    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- combined
  }
}

final_table <- bind_rows(results)

 
# 6. Write table
 

write.table(final_table,
            "Table_S3.txt",
            quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE,
            sep = "\t")

```

```{r}
data_7vN <- read.table("../final_sup_figures_data/S13_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt", header = TRUE)


# rfmix 7v7
data_rfmix <- read.table("../final_sup_figures_data/rfmix7v7_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt", header = TRUE)

data_7v48 <- data_7v48 %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)
data_7vN  <- data_7vN  %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)
data_rfmix <- data_rfmix %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)


discovery_hits <- data_7v48 %>%
  filter(abs(weighted_z) > 3) %>%
  arrange(CHR, POS)

discovery_collapsed <- collapse_hits(discovery_hits, window = 3e6)


lead_snps <- discovery_collapsed %>%
  select(
    CHR,
    Discovery_POS = POS,
    Discovery_Z = weighted_z,
    Discovery_P = p_value
  )


data_7vN_small <- data_7vN %>%
  select(
    CHR,
    POS,
    `7vN_Z` = weighted_z,
    `7vN_P` = p_value
  )

data_rfmix_small <- data_rfmix %>%
  select(
    CHR,
    POS,
    rfmix_7v7_Z = weighted_z,
    rfmix_7v7_P = p_value
  )


final_table_S2 <- lead_snps %>%
  left_join(data_7vN_small, 
            by = c("CHR", "Discovery_POS" = "POS")) %>%
  left_join(data_rfmix_small, 
            by = c("CHR", "Discovery_POS" = "POS"))



write.table(final_table_S2,
            "Table_S4.txt",
            quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE,
            sep = "\t")
```


#Table S5:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

 
# 0. Load data
 

# Discovery dataset
z_score_data <- read.table("../final_sup_figures_data/S13_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt", header = TRUE)

# replication datasets
rep_z_score_data <- read.table("../final_figures_data/rep2_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt", header = TRUE)
capture_z_score_data <- read.table("../final_figures_data/rep1_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt", header = TRUE)



 
# 1. Keep autosomes only
 

z_score_data <- z_score_data %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)
rep_z_score_data <- rep_z_score_data %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)
capture_z_score_data <- capture_z_score_data %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)

 
# 2. Filter |Z| > 3 in discovery
 

discovery_hits <- z_score_data %>%
  filter(abs(weighted_z) > 3) %>%
  arrange(CHR, POS)

 
# 3. Collapse regions within 3 Mb
 

collapse_hits <- function(df, window = 3e6) {
  
  df <- df %>% arrange(CHR, POS)
  kept <- list()
  
  for(chr in unique(df$CHR)) {
    
    chr_df <- df %>% filter(CHR == chr)
    
    while(nrow(chr_df) > 0) {
      
      lead <- chr_df[1, ]
      
      region <- chr_df %>%
        filter(abs(POS - lead$POS) <= window)
      
      # Keep lowest p-value
      best <- region %>% arrange(p_value) %>% slice(1)
      
      kept[[length(kept) + 1]] <- best
      
      chr_df <- chr_df %>%
        filter(abs(POS - best$POS) > window)
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(kept)
}

discovery_collapsed <- collapse_hits(discovery_hits, window = 3e6)

 
# 4. Replication function (2 Mb window ONLY)
 

find_replication <- function(row, rep_df, window = 2e6, p_thresh = 0.005) {
  
  chr <- row$CHR
  pos <- row$POS
  
  chr_rep <- rep_df %>% filter(CHR == chr)
  
  hits <- chr_rep %>% filter(abs(POS - pos) <= window)
  
  if(nrow(hits) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  best <- hits %>% arrange(p_value) %>% slice(1)
  
  tibble(
    Replication_POS = best$POS,
    Replication_Z = best$weighted_z,
    Replication_P = best$p_value,
    Distance_bp = abs(best$POS - pos),
    Replication_Significant = best$p_value < p_thresh,
    Any_Significant_2Mb = any(hits$p_value < p_thresh)
  )
}

 
# 5. Build final table (Akbari + Capture)
 

results <- list()

for(i in 1:nrow(discovery_collapsed)) {
  
  disc <- discovery_collapsed[i, ]
  
  # Akbari replication
  rep_akbari <- find_replication(disc, rep_z_score_data)
  
  # Capture replication
  rep_capture <- find_replication(disc, capture_z_score_data)
  
  if(!is.null(rep_akbari) | !is.null(rep_capture)) {
    
    if(!is.null(rep_akbari)){
      rep_akbari <- rep_akbari %>%
        rename_with(~paste0("Akbari_", .))
    }
    
    if(!is.null(rep_capture)){
      rep_capture <- rep_capture %>%
        rename_with(~paste0("Capture_", .))
    }
    
    combined <- bind_cols(
      tibble(
        CHR = disc$CHR,
        Discovery_POS = disc$POS,
        Discovery_Z = disc$weighted_z,
        Discovery_P = disc$p_value
      ),
      rep_akbari,
      rep_capture
    )
    
    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- combined
  }
}

final_table <- bind_rows(results)

 
# 6. Optional summary column
 

final_table <- final_table %>%
  mutate(
    Replicated_in_any = coalesce(Akbari_Replication_Significant, FALSE) |
                        coalesce(Capture_Replication_Significant, FALSE)
  )

 
# 7. Save table
 


final_table_clean <- final_table %>%
  transmute(
    CHR,
    
    # Discovery
    Discovery_POS,
    Discovery_Z,
    Discovery_P,
    
        # Rep1 (formerly Capture)
    Rep1_Z = Capture_Replication_Z,
    Rep1_P = Capture_Replication_P,
    Replicated_Rep1 = coalesce(Capture_Replication_Significant, FALSE),
    
    # Rep2 (formerly Akbari)
    Rep2_Z = Akbari_Replication_Z,
    Rep2_P = Akbari_Replication_P,
    Replicated_Rep2 = coalesce(Akbari_Replication_Significant, FALSE)
    
  )

write.table(final_table_clean,
           "Table_S5.txt",
            quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE,
            sep = "\t")
```
